# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery improvements**

## Highlights

This development build improves how SkiaSharp API documentation is authored, packaged, and delivered to consumers. Compiler-generated XML documentation now accompanies packages, while generated bindings and HarfBuzz metadata stay aligned with their native sources.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Package documentation is delivered from source comments** — API documentation is authored alongside the C# APIs and included as compiler XML sidecars, making the package documentation available directly to IDE consumers. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
- **Bindings follow pinned native sources** — Generated P/Invoke and HarfBuzz binding metadata are organized per type and derived from the native sources used to build the packages. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
